title: 3DWay: Generalizing Robot Manipulation via 3D Consistent Waypoints
abstract: arXiv:2609.08224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intermediate representations are key to bridging the modality gap between generalizable manipulation policies and large-scale pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). Among these, trajectory-based representations compactly represent motion-relevant cues, yet most existing approaches predict trajectories in 2D image space, resulting in intrinsic 3D ambiguity. Moreover, using 2D trajectories with depth still leaves the free-space waypoints ambiguous, limiting reliable 3D reasoning. To address this, we propose predicting 3D consistent waypoints (3DWay) from multi-view images. By reformulating 3D waypoints prediction as generating multi-view consistent 2D waypoints followed by geometric triangulation, we enable explicit 3D motion specification while preserving the strong priors of pretrained VLMs. The predicted waypoints can guide existing VLA models for better generalization or be directly executed on simple tasks. Extensive experiments

translated_title: 3DWay：通过3D一致路径点实现机器人操作的泛化
translated_abstract: 中间表征是弥合可泛化操作策略与大规模预训练视觉-语言模型之间模态鸿沟的关键。在这类表征中，基于轨迹的表征能够紧凑地表达与运动相关的线索，然而大多数现有方法在2D图像空间中预测轨迹，导致固有的3D歧义。此外，使用带深度信息的2D轨迹仍会使自由空间中的路径点存在歧义，限制了可靠的3D推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出从多视角图像中预测3D一致的路径点（3DWay）。通过将3D路径点预测重新表述为“先生成多视角一致的2D路径点、再进行几何三角测量”的过程，我们在保留预训练VLM强大先验的同时，实现了显式的3D运动规范。预测出的路径点可以引导现有的VLA模型以获得更好的泛化能力，也可以在简单任务上直接执行。大量实验（证明了该方法的有效性）。
tldr: 该论文提出3DWay方法，通过从多视角图像生成一致的2D路径点再进行几何三角测量来预测3D一致的路径点，在保留预训练视觉-语言模型先验的同时实现显式3D运动规范，从而提升机器人操作的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes 3DWay, which predicts 3D-consistent waypoints from multi-view images by generating multi-view consistent 2D waypoints followed by geometric triangulation, enabling explicit 3D motion specification while preserving pretrained VLM priors to improve generalization in robot manipulation.
